title: The Garden at Dawn
reflectionQuestion: Has someone ever spoken your name in a way that changed everything?
reflectionText: She came carrying spices, expecting death, expecting silence, expecting the worst to still be true. And then someone spoke her name — not a title, not an explanation. Her name. What is it to be known — truly known, by name, by someone you had thought lost — in a place where you had not come to look for him?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
